meta.title: Mauricio Correa — UI/UX design, web development and applied AI
meta.description: I design and build websites that are clear, memorable and built to convert, and connect them with AI and automation so your business works better. More than 10 years of experience.

hero.title: I turn ideas into digital experiences.
hero.lead: I design and build websites that are clear, memorable and built to convert. Then I connect them with AI and automation so your business works better, even when you're not there.

stat.label: building digital solutions for brands and companies.

manifesto.statement: Design is deciding what deserves to be seen.
manifesto.body: Every project starts with a simple question: what does your customer need to understand in the first few seconds? From there I organize, design, build and automate whatever it takes.

contact.title: Have a project in mind?
contact.body: Tell me what you want to achieve. Together we'll find the clearest way to bring it to the web and take the repetitive work off your plate.

work.title: The work speaks first.
work.lead: Each case connects the business challenge, the design decisions and the real site at work. No hidden steps.

archive.title: More projects
archive.lead: An additional selection of interfaces, stores and digital experiences.

capabilities.title: One idea. Four ways to make it work.
capabilities.lead: Design, development, AI and brand connected so your idea looks right, works better and works for you from day one.

process.title: From the first sketch to the published site.

steps.title: Discover
steps.body: I get to know your business, your audience and what the website needs to achieve. I also spot which tasks can be automated.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: Structure, prototype and visual design, approved with you before a single line of code is written.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Fast, responsive development that is easy to manage, using the technology that best fits your project.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: Publishing, final testing and ongoing support so your site and your automations keep growing.

items.label: years designing and building for the web.
connected capabilities: design, development, AI and brand.

about.title: Hi, I'm Mauricio Correa.
body: A graphic and web designer with more than a decade turning ideas into digital experiences that look good and work even better.
Today I bring artificial intelligence and automation into that craft: your brand tells its story clearly and your website works for you, with fewer manual tasks and more time for what matters.

principles.title: Creative innovation
principles.body: Original ideas and the right technology, AI included, to make your brand stand out.

principles.title: User experience
principles.body: Intuitive, easy-to-use web design for smooth navigation.

principles.title: Tailored solutions
principles.body: Solutions that reflect each client's identity and values.

principles.title: Quality and detail
principles.body: Careful attention to every detail for a flawless result.
